pay_detail: Unpaid. Thurber House can sign off on service hours. Interns provide their own transportation and lunch.
duration: Monday to Friday, at least 1 week (camp runs 8 weeks)
notes: Counselors must be 21 or older, so this intern role is the teen option. Confirm the age limit by email.
name: Summer Writing Camp Interns
what_you_do: Help camp counselors with activities for campers in grades 2 to 9. You go on field trips and get daily snacks ready. You do other tasks too. You work at least one week of an eight-week summer camp.
who_can_apply: High school and college students. The page does not state a minimum age or grade.
deadline_text: The page does not post an application deadline or interview dates. Contact Meg Brown by email.
how_to_apply: Email Meg Brown. She is the Director of Children's Education. Her address is megbrown@thurberhouse.org.
